title: Cardio Fitness: Foundations
welcome_lead: Strong heart, strong lungs — the engine room of every sport.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: heart rate, training zones, cardio fitness.
final_note: Keep moving regularly and your engine becomes a sports car.

walkthroughs.body_html: Place fingers on your wrist or neck. Count beats for 15 seconds, multiply by 4. That's your heart rate in BPM.
Quick estimate: 220 minus your age. A 13-year-old's max is roughly 207 BPM. Training zones are percentages of this.
Easy zone (~60%) builds base. Hard zone (~80%) builds top-end fitness. Mix both for the best results.
